_comment: Manifest of every image the game uses. `node scripts/generate-placeholders.mjs` reads this and writes an SVG placeholder for each entry into assets/images/<id>.svg, stamped with the description so you know what to draw. Replace the SVGs with real art later (keep the same filename, or change `file` here).

images.alt: As per my last email title screen
images.description: Title art: a sleek open-plan office at golden hour. A single empty corner office with a glass door glows invitingly at the back. Foreground desks have subtle signs of sabotage (a swapped nameplate, a hidden marker, a calendar with a moved meeting). Game logo 'As per my last email' in confident corporate sans-serif, with a tagline 'Can you win without becoming the worst person in the room?'

Neutral open-plan office background used behind scenes. Rows of desks, a glass meeting room, a whiteboard, plants, big windows. Slightly muted so foreground text/cards read clearly. Mild fluorescent-corporate vibe.
A glass-walled meeting room with a long table, a wall display showing a half-finished slide deck, scattered laptops and coffee cups. Used for demo/review scenes.
Office kitchen / breakout area: coffee machine, communal snacks, a passive-aggressive sticky note on the fridge. The natural habitat of rumors. Used for gossip/alliance scenes.
Player portrait: deliberately ambiguous, ambitious mid-level employee. Neutral pleasant expression that could read as sincere OR scheming depending on context. Lanyard with a blank badge.
Gary: warm, sharp-eyed, put-together but not flashy. Looks like he actually does the work. Holds a prototype/laptop. Genuinely kind smile that makes him hard to sabotage guilt-free.
Brian: overly confident, great hair, expensive-looking shirt, mid-gesture as if taking credit for something right now. Big practiced smile, eyes calculating.
Emily: effortlessly social, trophy emoji energy, holds a fancy coffee. Not skilled but utterly untouchable. Slightly bored, slightly amused expression.
Todd: tired, eager-to-please, surrounded by sticky notes, three energy drinks. Will do anything for praise. Slightly hunched, hopeful eyes with dark circles.
Linda: composed, observant manager. Reading glasses, arms crossed, the kind of calm that notices patterns. Hates drama, wants results. A look that says she's already three steps ahead of your excuse.

Full-body character cut-out of the player, transparent background, standing/gesturing pose for the visual-novel dialogue popup. Ambiguous ambitious employee, smart-casual, lanyard with blank badge. Readable as either sincere or scheming.
Full-body cut-out of Gary, transparent background, talking pose. Warm, sharp, put-together, holding a laptop/prototype. The competent one you feel guilty sabotaging. He actually does the work.
Full-body cut-out of Brian, transparent background, confident mid-gesture pose as if taking credit. Great hair, expensive shirt, practiced smile, calculating eyes.
Full-body cut-out of Emily, transparent background, relaxed untouchable pose with a fancy coffee. Effortlessly social, slightly bored, slightly amused — secretly the real saboteur.
Full-body cut-out of Todd, transparent background, anxious eager pose clutching an energy drink and sticky notes. Tired, hopeful, hunched, dark circles. Will do anything for praise.
Full-body cut-out of Linda the manager, transparent background, composed arms-crossed pose with reading glasses and a notebook. Calm, observant, three steps ahead of your excuse.

Full-body cut-out of the CEO / big boss, transparent background, expansive congratulatory pose (open arms or handshake offered). Expensive suit, slightly out-of-touch warmth, the person who hands out the promotion at the end.
